expected_claims.name: Scoro MCP
expected_claims.tagline: Vendor connector for Scoro workspace tasks, time entries and financial reads.
expected_claims.description: Scoro documents an official MCP connector for its general professional-services work-management platform. Current documentation lists read/write actions for projects, tasks, calendar events, comments, time entries and contacts, plus read access to financial documents. Workspace and user connections are required; enabled tools and existing user permissions determine access. This is not a separate legal-practice analytics product, and not every Scoro module is available through the connector. Documentation reviewed on October 27, 2026; customer-account access and deployed operation have not been tested.
expected_claims.pricing_details: Confirm current pricing, plan eligibility and limits with the vendor.
